products.name: Product Hunt MCP
products.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
products.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

products.name: Dageno AI 2.0
products.tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
products.description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

products.name: Databox CLI
products.tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
products.description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

products.name: Arcjet AI security models
products.tagline: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents
products.description: Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

products.name: ProtoMap
products.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies
products.description: ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

products.name: Voyager
products.tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
products.description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

products.name: Higgsfield Miracle
products.tagline: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest
products.description: Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

products.name: Co-Review
products.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
products.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

products.name: MCP1
products.tagline: One URL for every MCP server.
products.description: Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

products.name: GitHub New PR Overview
products.tagline: See what's blocking a PR before you scroll
products.description: GitHub's new pull request overview page moves merge status to the top, with checks, approvals, comments, and next actions in one compact summary. It also adds unresolved-comment filters, newest-first sorting, and an activity panel.

products.name: Cardboard AI
products.tagline: Best way to edit videos with AI
products.description: Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.

products.name: Pawse.ai
products.tagline: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans
products.description: Pawse.ai writes sound for your dog while it plays. Every session is shaped to how dogs hear. Choose Sleep, Home Alone, Loud Noise, Travel or Vet Visit. Tell it what your dog did and the next session adjusts. The Apple TV app keeps playing after you leave.

products.name: Jotform App for Shopify
products.tagline: Build powerful forms for your Shopify store
products.description: Bring Jotform’s powerful forms to your Shopify store. Create contact forms, lead forms, applications, registrations, surveys, and more. Match your store’s style, add conditional logic, calculations, and file uploads, and connect responses to the tools your team uses. Manage forms and submissions in Jotform, with your store as another place to reach customers.

products.name: Egoist AI Passport
products.tagline: Secure and share your personal data with AI tools.
products.description: AI Passport securely saves your personal data in one place, then lets you bring that context into the AI tools you use. Connect apps like Email, Calendar, ChatGPT, Claude, and more, choose exactly what data you want to share, and what you want to keep private, and revoke permissions whenever you want. Your AI tools get more personal, while your data stays yours.

products.name: Almanzor
products.tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
products.description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.
